# SavvPro

SavvPro is an AI-native technology organization. We build and operate AI-native
platforms and deliver AI-powered services to organizations navigating the
transition into the agentic era.

Tagline: Intelligence backbone for the agentic era.
Phase: stealth (May 2026).

## What we build
- AI-native capabilities (formally defined, measured, continuously improving production processes)
- Platforms and infrastructure that operate those capabilities in production

## How we operate
- No management layer. Three roles: Individual Contributor, Directly Responsible Individual, Player-Coach.
- An explicit World Model coordinates work — humans operate at the edge as judgment engines.
- Remote-first, resource-agnostic, agent-first.

## Doctrines (machine-readable, same origin)
The four published doctrines are served directly from this origin as plain
markdown. Each is a formal operating-principle document — not a blog post.

- https://savv.pro/library/end-of-the-hierarchy.md
- https://savv.pro/library/capabilities-over-features.md
- https://savv.pro/library/world-model-imperative.md
- https://savv.pro/library/partner-doctrine.md

## Organisational state
Current counts (doctrines published, capabilities defined, last revised) live
in machine-readable JSON. Canonical source is
/agent-context.json; /data/org-state.json is a small derived subset.
- /agent-context.json   (canonical, full bundle)
- /data/org-state.json  (derived state subset)

## Single-fetch agent context
For one-shot complete context — org state, doctrine summaries, contributor
pathway, agent scope — fetch:
- /agent-context.json

## What this site's agent handles
- Questions about what SavvPro builds and how it operates
- The contributor pathway and what SavvPro looks for
- The arguments of the four published doctrines

## What this site's agent does not handle
- Client names, project details, financial data
- Team member personal contact details
- Internal Skill Profile data or capability cost profiles
- Specific commercial terms or partnership details
- Roadmap dates or feature delivery promises
- Identities of any current partners or ecosystem members

## Source
This site is built as plain HTML. No build pipeline. The source is meant to be
readable as a document.
- Site repo: https://github.com/savvpro/savv.pro
- Org: https://github.com/savvpro
